findings.title: Functions renamed and moved with no compatibility re-exports
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` was renamed to `try_incident_threshold` in `logic/incidents.py`. `create_issue_platform_occurrence` was renamed to `create_incident_occurrence` in `logic/incident_occurrence.py`. `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` and `SimpleCheckIn` were also moved out of `mark_failed.py`. Nothing is re-exported from the old module, and the PR changes no other callers or tests. Any existing import or `mock.patch` target of `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.<name>` (for example in the mark_failed tests) will now fail with ImportError or AttributeError. Either update those references in this PR or keep aliases in `mark_failed.py`.

findings.title: Copied config with readable schedule_type is computed but never used
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies the monitor config and replaces `schedule_type` with its human-readable label. It then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config`, the original unmodified dict, instead of the local `config`. As a result the monitor context on the issue event shows the raw `schedule_type` value rather than the display label. The bug predates this PR but is carried into the new module; returning `config` would fix it.
